blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. A pizza costs twelve dollars plus two dollars for each topping. Three friends share the cost equally. Write an expression for what each friend pays when there are x toppings.
blocks.display: A pizza costs 12 dollars plus 2 dollars for each topping. Three friends share the cost equally. Write an expression for what each friend pays when there are x toppings.

blocks.text: The pizza costs twelve plus two for each topping, so with x toppings that is twelve plus two x.
That whole cost is shared equally by three friends, so the sum goes on top.
Dividing the whole sum by three gives the share of each friend.
So the answer is twelve plus two x three. Test it. If x is six, the expression gives eight.
Watch out for these traps. If you divide only the toppings, you get twelve plus two x over three. If you forget the sharing, you get twelve plus two x.
